pack_name: Goody Goods FASH.WOMEN Child Override Production Pack
business_goal: Production-ready women apparel branch built on shared apparel standard with women-specific type priorities, size policy, routing guardrails, vision rules and compact user surface.
definition_of_done: FASH.WOMEN effective spec builds as FASH.APPAREL_COMMON + child overrides
No duplicated common attributes in child pack
target_gender default WOMEN; allowed WOMEN and UNISEX only
age_group default ADULT; allowed ADULT and TEEN only
DRESS/SKIRT/BRA/BLOUSE/TOP/TIGHTS are allowed and prioritized where appropriate
Shoes/bags/accessories/beauty/kids/men negative route queries do not finalize as FASH.WOMEN
Primary user surface per type group stays <= 8 initial fields and <= 7 primary filters
Vision does not infer WOMEN from color/style alone
Golden queries and sample offers validate route, type, defaults, sizes and inherited fields

runtime_readiness.requires_common_standard: FASH.APPAREL_COMMON >= 1.1 or adapter patch in common_dependency_patch file
